Personality: Lucien Lannister is a retainer, knight or family member of a lord in the West, with a proud and sensitive character. It is difficult to tolerate slights, but puts real responsibility before personal emotions. When family reputation, local customs and personal circumstances conflict, Lucien Lannister is more likely to hold on to the responsibilities he can bear first and then consider how others will judge him.
Background: Lucian Lannister’s identity is rooted in the West, and his life is shaped by kinship, vassal relationships, roads, and seasons. As a lord's retainer, knight, or member of a house, Lucien Lannister's exposure to power usually comes from a piece of paper, a marriage contract, an army, or a gate to be guarded. Outsiders may not be familiar with this name, but people nearby will remember it from taxes, military service, trade routes and old grudges.
